profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at FactSet
profile.summary:
I'm currently pursuing my masters from North Carolina State University in the field of Computer Science. Having worked with FactSet for two years, I've got acquainted with working in a team and have a good communication and rapport with my seniors, peers as well as juniors.

I've done my Bachelors from Nirma University in India in the field of Computer Science. During the bachelors, I was working with Computer Society of India(CSI) to organize many different level technical as well as non-technical fests, which helped me to bag the position of the General Secretary of the CSI student branch in my university. This helped me to gain some experience in the field of leadership as well.

Through out my schooling days, I've always been keen to participate in sports and have successfully participated in two national level Karate championships.

Personally, I'm an easy going guy who loves to do his work with full sincerity, hard work and dedication.

positions.title: PSC Intern
positions.description:
PSC stands for Planning, Steering and Control. The team essentially is responsible for creating business solutions for the company. As a part of the team, I was part of revamping the demand management tool which the company uses. This gave me an insight to the way ServiceNow is designed and is being used.

The other key task was to utilize my expertise with AngularJS and create a tool in ServiceNow which can migrate the knowledge articles from Wiki to ServiceNow. The tool gives the users full flexibility and control on the migration process and can migrate the articles with precise content.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working with FactSet was a very good experience. During the time there, I developed and owned the printing service which was used by multiple client facing applications. 

I also developed numerous important enhancements in Portfolio Analysis 3.0. Besides PA3, I was also responsible for full stack development of Portfolio Asset Types and Composite Asset Builder. While working with this apps, I got acquainted with AngularJS, Node.js, C++, HTML, CSS and TypeScript.

projects.title: Latex Made Easy
projects.description:
The project mainly focuses on helping the techies to avoid writing latex code. Our app will be providing UI components to the users for all the complex items encountered while writing a technical document (eg. equations, tables, titles, authors etc.).

 At the end, once the user provides the data, the app will generate downloadable latex code for the document and also provide a downloadable pdf corresponding to the document. 

We are aiming to reduce the time taken by the users for writing latex code even if that is using templates as UI components will make it much more convenient for use.

projects.title: Lexis Nexis Hackathon ChatBot
projects.description:
This is a project developed as a part of the Lexis Nexis Hackathon organized on October 13-14, 2017 at the Lexis Nexis office in Raleigh, NC. The project required to create a chatbot which replies based on the users questions and searching through thousands of cases. The chatbot should also ask questions to the user to narrow down the search.

The important technologies used includes Elasticsearch, Node.js, JavaScript, HTML, jQuery.
